attempt.claim: The vector form `scan row FILE` scans each JSON string on its own and never the key with its value, so a row that assigns a long value to a secret-named key is reported clean. Ledger rows are JSON objects, so this is the usual way a credential would appear in one.

reproducer.cmd: cd referee && python3 -c "import json;k='pass'+'word';open('/tmp/r.jsonl','w').write(json.dumps({'row_id':'r1',k:'Zx9kLm2pQrs7Tv'})+'\n')" && python3 -m gate.secrets scan row /tmp/r.jsonl 2>&1
